sections.heading: Sharing model
sections.markdown:
- `const T` is the ordinary deep-read-only capability; audited synchronization handles normalize to an internal synchronized shared capability
- a `go` closure may not capture any outer `var`, even for reads
- pass local data as explicit `go` arguments using ordinary inline values, `copy(...)`, or `move`
- mutable state shared by coroutines must flow through Channel, Atomic, or audited sync handles; direct captured mutation is a compile error
- module-mutable state and short-lived views/pointers are rejected, and `unsafe` does not relax these rules

sections.heading: await all
sections.markdown: Plain waiting is always `await task`; there is no `await (move task)` form. A unique mutable result makes that await a compiler-proven one-time terminal take. `await all` requires a homogeneous collection of tasks: every element must have the same static `Task<T>` type, and the result is `Array<T>`.

sections.heading: Atomic
sections.markdown: `Atomic<T>` wraps `i64`/`f64`/`bool` with lock-free atomic operations. Name it with `const`; its audited methods provide synchronized interior mutation. Methods: `load`, `store`, `add`, `sub`, `fetchAdd`, `fetchSub`, `swap`, `compareExchange`, `toggle`. Optional `Ordering` enum parameter (default `SeqCst`).

sections.heading: Synchronization handles
sections.markdown: Name `Channel`, `Atomic`, coroutine-domain `sync.*` handles, and OS-thread-domain `sys.Os*` handles with `const`. Use `sync.*` inside coroutine code; use `sys.Os*` inside `sys.Thread` or other blocking OS-thread contexts.
